summary: Executed pytest suite (14/14 passed) and full mobile-web Playwright walkthrough of LocalLoop. Backend endpoints (auth/dev-session, events list+filter, single event, 404, create-with-Bearer, checkin toggle, checkin-status, 401s) are all green. Frontend login->demo->map-home->pin->event-sheet->checkin->add-event->publish->back-to-map end-to-end works. Category filter chips correctly reduce visible pins (nightlife=3, food=2, all=10). Theme toggle works. Missing testIDs on Add Event form (category-chip-*, date-preset-*) and a 422 seen on one submit attempt where defaults were used.

ui_bugs.issue: Category chips render (Nightlife/Food/Sports/Culture) but lack data-testid="category-chip-<cat>" attributes required by the test spec.
Date preset chips render (Tonight 8PM / Tomorrow 7PM / Saturday 9PM / Next week) but lack data-testid="date-preset-*" attributes required by the test spec.

integration_issues.issue: Observed one 422 response in browser console during Publish Event (with defaults, no category/date preset tapped due to missing testIDs). UI still navigated back to map-home despite the 422. Consider surfacing an error toast on non-2xx and/or verifying payload defaults (start_time, category) always satisfy Pydantic model.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); React 19 element.ref access warning. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Add data-testid="category-chip-<cat>" on each Category chip in /app/frontend/app/add-event.tsx (nightlife, food, sports, culture).
Add data-testid="date-preset-<key>" on each Date & Time preset chip (tonight, tomorrow, saturday, nextweek).

Show user-visible error state on Publish Event 422 instead of silently navigating back; verify default payload (start_time when no preset tapped, category default) satisfies backend Pydantic requirements.
(Nice-to-have) Replace deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props and audit React 19 ref access warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend responses cleanly exclude MongoDB _id (no leakage observed).
dev-session correctly gated by ALLOW_DEV_LOGIN=true — good.
live_count jitter is by design; test suite correctly avoids exact-value asserts on it.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical flows work; 2 missing testIDs, 1 stray 422)

seed_data_creation: Pytest created TEST_Event_* via /api/events (auth). One extra event also created through UI as TEST_UI_Event_2 during Playwright. Cleanup not performed (test-only data, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing at /app/backend/tests/test_localloop_api.py. Frontend: login->map->pin->sheet->checkin->fab->add-event->publish->back all work. Only pending items are (a) add category-chip-* and date-preset-* testIDs on add-event.tsx and (b) investigate 422 on default submit. Preview URL uses fallback web map with positioned pins (map-pin-<id>).
rca_of_issue: Missing testIDs: chips are likely rendered inside a shared component without forwarding a testID prop per option — pass testID={`category-chip-${cat}`} / testID={`date-preset-${key}`} on the TouchableOpacity for each chip. 422 on submit likely caused by missing/invalid start_time when no preset is tapped or category default mismatch — verify AddEvent state initializes both category and start_time to valid values matching backend Pydantic schema.
